limits: Installed build coverage, not a claim to contain every historical patch/version.
Structural metrics cover all listed SD source entries; visual inspection is a sample, not every catalogue model.
Path/tag families include supporting variants; triangle totals include hidden geometry and LODs.
One resource can contain many models; packs do not count as many independently rated resources.
UI and portrait framing/engine replaceables need their intended runtime context; unresolved references cannot certify appearance.
Native renderer captures are not Warcraft III gameplay tests.
